WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
         sum(f.net_amount) AS net_all, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_staff,
         sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id < 900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_stores,
         sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id >= 900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_pseudo,
         sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code='WB' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_wb,
         min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
  FROM per p JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
  JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
  GROUP BY 1
),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_all, sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id<900 THEN r.refund_net ELSE 0 END) AS refunds_stores, count(*) AS n_ret, count(DISTINCT r.return_line_id) AS dist_ret
  FROM per p JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key GROUP BY 1
),
rpt AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, sum(d.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_gross, sum(d.returns_net) AS rpt_ret, sum(d.net_sales) AS rpt_net, count(*) AS rpt_rows, count(DISTINCT d.store_id) AS rpt_stores
  FROM per p JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales d ON d.business_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT * FROM sales JOIN ret USING (fiscal_year) JOIN rpt USING (fiscal_year) ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, st.store_id, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS sale_days,
         sum(f.net_amount) AS net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS staff
  FROM per p JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2
),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds
  FROM per p JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE st.store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1,2
),
rpt AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, d.store_id, sum(d.net_sales) AS rpt_net FROM per p JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales d ON d.business_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT s.store_id,
  max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN sale_days END) AS d25, max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN sale_days END) AS d26,
  max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END) AS net25, max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END) AS net26,
  max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.refunds END) AS ref25, max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r.refunds END) AS ref26,
  max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN staff END) AS staff25, max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN staff END) AS staff26,
  max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN rpt_net END) AS rpt25, max(CASE WHEN s.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN rpt_net END) AS rpt26
FROM sales s LEFT JOIN ret r USING (fiscal_year, store_id) LEFT JOIN rpt USING (fiscal_year, store_id)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
)
SELECT p.fiscal_year,
  count(*) AS lines_all,
  count(st.store_key) AS lines_matched_store,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty,
  max(f.net_amount) AS max_net, min(f.net_amount) AS min_net,
  sum(CASE WHEN CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) <> f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS utc_date_diff,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN st.valid_from AND st.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store_version_off,
  count(DISTINCT f.channel_code) AS n_channel_codes,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_channel,
  sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id >= 900 AND f.channel_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'WB' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pseudo_not_wb,
  sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id < 900 AND f.channel_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'ST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS store_not_st,
  sum(CASE WHEN st.store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS training_lines
FROM per p JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e LEFT JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.fiscal_year, count(*) AS n_ret,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_returns,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_refund,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_gt_sale,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.return_date < f.sale_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS return_before_sale,
  count(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS dist_sales_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN s2.store_id <> s1.store_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS diff_store_than_sale,
  max(r.refund_net) AS max_refund,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(r.refund_gross - r.refund_net*(1+r.vat_rate)) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS vat_mismatch

LEFT JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id

LEFT JOIN dim_store s2 ON s2.store_key = r.store_key
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e,
         CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END AS side
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
),
stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id < 900
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT st.store_id FROM stores st
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_store d WHERE d.store_id = st.store_id AND d.is_current
                    AND ((d.open_date IS NOT NULL AND d.open_date > (SELECT min(s) FROM periods))
                      OR (d.close_date IS NOT NULL AND d.close_date < (SELECT max(e) FROM periods))))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c, periods p WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= p.e AND c.closure_end_date >= p.s)
    AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key, periods p
         WHERE d.store_id = st.store_id AND f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e) = 56
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.side, d.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_sales FROM periods p
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE d.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores) GROUP BY 1, 2
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.side, d.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS refund_net FROM periods p
  JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE d.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores) GROUP BY 1, 2
),
net AS (
  SELECT s.side, s.store_id, s.net_sales - coalesce(r.refund_net, 0) AS net_sales_after_returns
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (side, store_id)
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  count(DISTINCT store_id) AS n_stores,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN side='cur' THEN net_sales_after_returns END), 2) AS cur_net,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN side='prior' THEN net_sales_after_returns END), 2) AS prior_net,
  round((sum(CASE WHEN side='cur' THEN net_sales_after_returns END) / sum(CASE WHEN side='prior' THEN net_sales_after_returns END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct,
  round((sum(CASE WHEN side='cur' AND store_id NOT IN (136,137) THEN net_sales_after_returns END) / sum(CASE WHEN side='prior' AND store_id NOT IN (136,137) THEN net_sales_after_returns END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS growth_ex_136_137,
  round((sum(CASE WHEN side='cur' AND store_id NOT IN (125) THEN net_sales_after_returns END) / sum(CASE WHEN side='prior' AND store_id NOT IN (125) THEN net_sales_after_returns END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS growth_ex_125,
  string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), ',') FILTER (WHERE store_id IN (125,119,136,137,129)) AS flagged_included
FROM net

WITH f AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN x.sale_date >= DATE '2026-08-03' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END AS side, x.net_amount, x.staff_purchase_flag
  FROM fact_sales_line x JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = x.store_key
  WHERE d.store_id < 900 AND d.store_id <> 129
    AND (x.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' OR x.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24')
)
SELECT side, round(sum(net_amount),2) AS gross_of_returns, round(sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS staff_net,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 0 ELSE net_amount END),2) AS ex_staff
FROM f GROUP BY 1

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e,
         CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' THEN 'cur' ELSE 'prior' END AS side
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.store_id FROM dim_store st
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= (SELECT min(s) FROM periods))
    AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= (SELECT max(e) FROM periods))
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c, periods p WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= p.e AND c.closure_end_date >= p.s)
    AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key, periods p
         WHERE d.store_id = st.store_id AND f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e) = 56
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.side, sum(f.net_amount) AS v FROM periods p
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE d.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores) GROUP BY 1
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT p.side, sum(r.refund_net) AS v FROM periods p
  JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e JOIN dim_store d ON d.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE d.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores) GROUP BY 1
),
net AS (SELECT s.side, s.v - coalesce(r.v, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (side))
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  round((max(CASE WHEN side = 'cur' THEN net_sales END) / max(CASE WHEN side = 'prior' THEN net_sales END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_net_sales_growth_pct
FROM net
